from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json

root = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation')
preview = root / 'offline-preview'
live = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/live-baseline.html').read_bytes()
candidate = (preview / 'index-preview.html').read_bytes()
example = (preview / 'worked-example-en-fr.md').read_bytes()
original_example = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/worked-example-en-fr.md').read_bytes()

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, data):
        super().__init__()
        self.links = []
        self.ids = []
        self.feed(data.decode('utf-8'))

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'a' and 'href' in attrs:
            self.links.append(attrs['href'])
        if 'id' in attrs:
            self.ids.append(attrs['id'])

start = candidate.find(b'<section id="editor-worked-example"')
end_tag = candidate.find(b'</section>', start) if start >= 0 else -1
end = end_tag + len(b'</section>') if end_tag >= 0 else -1
before, after = Page(live), Page(candidate)
restores = end >= 0 and any(candidate[:start] + candidate[end + n:] == live for n in range(3) if candidate[end:end+n].strip() == b'')
checks = {
    'removing_example_section_restores_live_capture': restores,
    'exactly_two_example_links_added': after.links.count('worked-example-en-fr.md') == before.links.count('worked-example-en-fr.md') + 2,
    'all_existing_links_and_order_preserved': [link for link in after.links if link != 'worked-example-en-fr.md'] == before.links,
    'example_bytes_match_staged_original': example == original_example,
    'price_review_ids_match_captured_live': all(after.ids.count(name) == before.ids.count(name) for name in ('price-update-review-en', 'price-update-review-fr')),
}
result = {'scope': 'Offline HTML and download checks against the saved live capture. No live deployment, approval or commercial outcome tested.', 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all(checks.values()), 'sha256': {name: sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in [('live_capture', live), ('offline_preview', candidate), ('worked_example', example)]}}
output = root / 'director-offline-example-controls.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

description: The saved catalogue homepage and checkout differ. The checkout adds two price-review sections, while the offline worked example adds two links. That difference changes what can safely enter the next release candidate. Trace the price-review sections to their mission and review records, then test the worked example against the saved live homepage without editing the checkout.
